project.title: [Company] — Brand System Build
project.summary: Comprehensive brand system including identity, guidelines, collateral templates, and digital asset library for consistent brand application.
objectives: Complete brand identity system with logo, palette, typography, imagery
Comprehensive brand guidelines for internal and external use
Digital asset library for consistent brand application

included: Full logo system (primary, secondary, icon, variations)
Typography system (headings, body, UI, web-safe fallbacks)
Collateral templates: stationery, social media, presentations, email signatures
Digital asset library (Figma/shared folder with organized assets)
exclusions: Ongoing brand maintenance (Brand Care is separate and optional)

timeline.notes: Estimated; final schedule confirmed at agreement

vat.note: VAT status is unresolved; no tax determination is made in this proposal.

client_responsibilities: Timely feedback on concepts, design, and guidelines review stages
Brand strategy inputs before design phase
Approval of collateral content before template finalisation
assumptions: Approved Final Project Price is the contractual commercial basis, not the public From price
No third-party costs (fonts, stock images, photography) are included without prior approval
Asset library is delivered via shared cloud folder; client manages access
next_steps: Following acceptance, a commercial agreement is executed before invoicing
